turns.text: Hello, I want to return a print and get the money back. I ordered the wrong size.
Hello, I can help with that. To find your order, please send me the order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with.
The order is SC-3744 and the email is claire.fontaine@example.com.

Thank you, Claire. I found order SC-3744 for the Last Lantern print. Because this refund is above the amount I can approve, I have passed your request to a colleague, who will take over this chat and decide on the return and refund. I have not filed the return yet, so please wait for their reply.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.
